d: Long, straight midnight blue hair with blunt bangs and two long strands framing the face, adorned with silver hair ornaments and red ribbons. Narrow, slanted midnight blue eyes with a serene expression. A youthful, mature face with a slender build. A white and lime green sleeveless dress with a black floral patterned lower half, featuring a white shawl draped over the arm and a small golden bell hanging from a black cord around the neck.
